title: Outdoor Croatian Saskatoon Berry Skewers
description: A traditional Croatian dish featuring Saskatoon berries, with a fluffy and umami flavor profile, made FODMAP-friendly and perfect for outdoor adventures. This recipe is a unique blend of Croatian cuisine and Canadian ingredients.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the sliced onion, mushrooms, and bell pepper to the bowl and toss to coat with the oil mixture.
Thread the marinated vegetables, pork sausage, and Saskatoon berries onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the sausage is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Remove the skewers from the heat and let them rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional Saskatoon berries if desired.
To namul-blanch-season the Saskatoon berries, simply rinse them with cold water, then soak them in cold water for 30 minutes, and finally drain and rinse them again.
To add an extra layer of flavor, serve the skewers with a side of namul-blanch-seasoned Saskatoon berries.
